gaps.lead: The athlete denied taking performance-enhancing drugs.
gaps.explanation: deny + having + past participle (or deny taking).

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: The number of students is falling.
gaps.explanation: go down = decrease. Also acceptable: is coming down.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen such a good film for ages.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ I had seen for ages.
gaps.explanation: Not…such a good film for ages = the best film (I had seen) for ages.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: Only after reading the letter twice did it make sense.
gaps.sentence: The letter ___ sense until he had read it twice.
gaps.explanation: It didn't make sense until… = it made sense only after…
